parsed.explanation: The write-up explicitly leaves the universal upper bound open and correctly identifies the gap: a small ternary signed sum obtained by pigeonhole is not shown to correspond to a legal Xiang strategy using at most n cuts. No other passage supplies the required mirrored-cut/overlay construction or an equivalent all-n realization argument. Establishing L3.2 therefore requires a substantive lemma, not a symbolic or one-sentence correction.
